parsed.name: Prior弧光灯快门
parsed.description: 用于控制Prior弧光灯照明光路的快门，在显微和光学实验中实现照明的开启、关闭与状态查询，以便允许或阻断光线照射样品。
parsed.description_en: A shutter used to control the illumination path of a Prior arc lamp. In microscopy and optical experiments, it is used to enable or block lamp light and to query the shutter state.

actions.description: 查询弧光灯快门是否处于开启状态。
actions.description_en: Check whether the arc lamp shutter is open/on.

actions.description: 打开弧光灯快门，使照明光通过。
actions.description_en: Open the arc lamp shutter to allow illumination to pass.

actions.description: 关闭弧光灯快门，阻断照明光。
actions.description_en: Close the arc lamp shutter to block illumination.
